MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.

3. When learning Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.

4. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

5. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

7. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.

8. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

9. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

11. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Media Technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — CPU

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.

6. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

10. A — Information and Communication Technology

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques.

12. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fundamentals of Media Technology; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pre- production; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
